rationale: Least-cost commitment meeting demand (260 MW) + reserve (40 MW) = 300 MW requirement with N-1 security. g1+g2+g3 provides 460 MW total, survives loss of largest unit g3 (180 MW) leaving 280 MW > 260 MW demand. Cost: 400+80+550+100+700+120 = 1950 USD. Other combinations either insufficient capacity or fail N-1.
